name: SolShip
source:
Deep in space, the Brainwave Ascension Launch-Liftoff Spaceship (BALLS) explores the steamy depths of the galaxies. When pilots Sol and Chet encounter an unknown enemy, they find themselves plunged into an endless war. 

The Extraterrestrial Glowing Gametes (EGGs) threaten humanity's end. Between ship and alien, creation and destruction, BALLS and EGGs...

Where does Sol stand?

[From [url=https://nsfwbitrrrary.itch.io/solship]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
太空深处，“脑波升华发射升空飞船”（BALLS）正在探索银河深处火热的领域。飞行员索尔与切特遭遇未知敌人后，发现自己被卷入了一场无休止的战争。

“外星发光配子”（EGGs）威胁着人类的存续。在飞船与外星生物之间、创造与毁灭之间、BALLS与EGGs之间……

索尔会站在哪一边？
